Google has launched a new "home" for Google Business Profiles named Google Business Home. It is a beta, but I just received an email with access to the new Google Business Home. Google wrote, "This beta experience brings together your Business Profile, Merchant Center, YouTube, and Ads accounts all in one place. With Business Home you can turn insights about your business and customers into quick, actionable steps to help you grow."
It seems Google has been rolling this out slowly over the past couple of months to some businesses.
Google Business Home allows you to:
- Create, publish, and track content performance in one place
- Easily manage multiple locations
- Find personalized advice for your business goals
- Plus much more...
It is interesting that Google is bringing back this portal, I mean, they had it for Google My Business to Google Business Profiles and then dropped the concept of a portal to manage your business instead directly in Google Search.
